verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.dataset_name: Veltri / DAMP / AMP Scanner v2 original test set
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.length_evidence: The full 1,778 + 1,778 dataset has mean length about 34 aa; the exact 10-50 aa fraction must be measured after download.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.deduplication_method: Original publication reports <=40% pairwise sequence identity for the curated dataset; rerun the current benchmark homology gate.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.independence_scope: Not an independent external test for AMP Scanner v2, APIN/APIN-fusion, AMP-BERT, ACEP or any model trained/tuned on the Veltri split. It may be used for other models only after training-overlap audit.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.description: APIN reused the Veltri/DAMP split; APIN benchmarking set is therefore an alias/usage relationship, not a separate dataset.

verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.independence_scope: The AMPSorter test/benchmark sheets are model-associated and cannot be called independent for AMPSorter without reconstructing their relationship to training. The external-validation sheet is the preferred extraction target, still subject to overlap audit.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.description: Zenodo explicitly documents separate AMPSorter test, benchmarking and external-validation worksheets; the agent must enumerate workbook sheets rather than treating the DOI as one opaque dataset.

verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.dataset_name: C_AMPs-predict under-50-aa test and benchmark data
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.length_evidence: Official repository describes the test data as under 50 aa; minimum length and the exact 10-50 aa fraction must be measured.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.independence_scope: Model-associated data cannot be used as an independent test for C_AMPs-predict. It can nominate short-peptide sequences for other models only after provenance and training-overlap audits.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.description: The repository contains explicit AMP and non-AMP FASTA files, but sample counts, negative construction and split identity must be audited before selection.

verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.dataset_role: negative-sampling robustness and external benchmark candidate
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.length_evidence: Negative sampling strategies include length-matched variants; exact 10-50 aa coverage must be measured on the selected replication.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.deduplication_method: Positive data were split before negative sampling to reduce leakage; rerun exact and <=40% identity audits locally.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.independence_scope: Preferred robustness candidate because it exposes negative-set bias, but independence is model-specific and must be established against training references.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.description: Useful as a stress-test family rather than a single opaque test set; preserves multiple negative-construction scenarios and replications.

verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.length_evidence: not_reported_in_verified_snapshot; must pass the project 10-50 aa coverage gate after download.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.independence_scope: Not independent for MAPLE and derived partly from iAMPCN/public AMP resources; use for other models only after cross-database label and homology audit.
verified_dataset_acquisition_candidates.description: Adds a naturally imbalanced recent candidate, but its size does not override the length, provenance and leakage gates.

meeting_recommended_datasets.why_selected: Potential balanced set for baseline testing; ABP-Finder used it for antibacterial sub-classification, may be adapted for general AMP with proper negative set.
meeting_recommended_datasets.evidence_for_profile: ABP-Finder used balanced ABP/non-ABP from StarPep; exact counts and balance unverified.
meeting_recommended_datasets.independence_limitations: May overlap with other AMP databases; independence from training sets of other models not guaranteed.
meeting_recommended_datasets.required_cleaning: Sequence deduplication, length filtering, negative set audit for non-AMP peptides.

meeting_recommended_datasets.why_selected: Explicitly balanced dataset with known positive and negative counts; can serve as a benchmark for balanced performance.
meeting_recommended_datasets.evidence_for_profile: ABP_XGBoost manuscript reports 3919 positive and 3919 negative peptides.
meeting_recommended_datasets.independence_limitations: Negative set derived from UniProt; may include sequences with antimicrobial activity not annotated as ABP.
meeting_recommended_datasets.required_cleaning: Verify deduplication, check for sequence homology with other benchmark sets, confirm negative set composition.

meeting_recommended_datasets.target_profile: imbalanced (negative set to be constructed from non-AMP sequences)
meeting_recommended_datasets.why_selected: Large AMP set; constructing a severe imbalanced set (e.g., 1:100) from dbAMP positives and random non-AMP negatives could test robustness.
meeting_recommended_datasets.evidence_for_profile: dbAMP contains 6845 multi-label AMPs; negative set not defined. MultiAMP used multi-label, not binary.
meeting_recommended_datasets.independence_limitations: Negative set may be contaminated with unannotated AMPs; homology to training sets of other models must be controlled.
meeting_recommended_datasets.required_cleaning: Define binary negative set, perform CD-HIT clustering, balance prevalence.

meeting_dataset_decision_trace.scout_proposal: Proposed by Scout as a candidate from ABP-Finder.
meeting_dataset_decision_trace.metrics_review: Potential candidate for balanced/mild imbalanced set, but missing critical metadata. Requires sequence audit.
meeting_dataset_decision_trace.critic_reason: Missing direct download link and statistics. Not ready for benchmark matrix.
meeting_dataset_decision_trace.chief_final: Deferred but selected as top recommendation (rank 1) due to near-balanced potential; marked as needing sequence audit and link verification.

meeting_dataset_decision_trace.metrics_review: May serve as source for severe imbalanced set if negative samples are drawn from non-AMP databases. Requires sequence audit.
meeting_dataset_decision_trace.critic_reason: Lacks explicit negative set; multi-label setting not suitable for binary AMP classification.
meeting_dataset_decision_trace.chief_final: Deferred but selected as rank 3 with condition to build binary negative set; needs sequence audit and negative set construction.

meeting_dataset_decision_trace.metrics_review: Too narrow for general AMP benchmark (only defensins).
meeting_dataset_decision_trace.chief_final: Rejected: not suitable for main benchmark matrix.
